remarks: Welcome to Fountain Terrace...one of Stamford's most desirable condo associations just minutes from Downtown Stamford's best offerings. This is a fully remodeled 1BD corner unit with northwest exposure from an oversized balcony. Beautiful flow, light and bright, new vinyl flooring, fully remodeled kitchen with stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops. Great size bedroom and generous closet space. This association offers 24/7 security, elevators, laundry on premises, exercise room, outdoor seasonal pool, bike room, off street parking as well as guest parking. HEAT, HOT WATER AND COOKING GAS are included in rent. Beautiful unit is ready for its new tenant...don't wait!!! Grab it, unpack and enjoy all that Stamford has to offer including its beautiful beaches, shopping and restaurants, parks and recreation, daily entertainment/night life and ease of public transportation/commute to I-95 and Merritt Pkwy as well as proximity to nearby towns Greenwich, Darien and New Canaan.
